item.title: Mercer Island School District faces $13.4M sex abuse claim
item.description: School leaders received numerous reports that former high school English teacher Curtis Johnston was “dating” a student but failed to intervene, complaint says.

item.title: Island business owners, residents share their thoughts on light rail
item.description: As Rick Haney strolled along 77th Avenue Southeast on a recent afternoon, the new Mercer Island Light Rail Station sat empty to his left. The facility was looking very lonely and needing a crowd of people to bring it to life.

item.title: Islander sentenced to two years in prison for embezzling $35 million from former company
item.description: Four months after being convicted on four counts of wire fraud, Mercer Island’s Nevin Shetty received a two-year prison sentence on March 5 in U.S. District Court in Seattle.

item.title: MISD selected to receive a State Superintendent’s Award for Educational Excellence
item.description: State Superintendent Chris Reykdal has selected the Mercer Island School District (MISD) along with 24 other school districts to receive the Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction’s inaugural award in educational achievement in the previous school year.

item.title: Mercer Island Senior Resource Fair draws a big crowd
item.description: The city’s Parks and Recreation Division and Youth and Family Services (YFS) Department held the free, third annual Mercer Island Senior Resource Fair on March 7 at the Mercer Island Community and Event Center. It was all about making connections and obtaining information about health and wellness, lifestyle enrichment, personal safety and more. item.title: Tree removal set for this week on section of 74th Ave. SE
item.description: From today through Friday on Mercer Island, Puget Sound Energy (PSE) and arbor crews will remove five large conifer trees from the right-of-way in front of 2962 74th Ave. SE (see blue shaded area on map). According to the city, one tree has died and others have shed — or are at risk of shedding — tops and branches.
